limitations: Eight teacher-forced steps are not complete natural generation quality or an accepted global-logit contract.
No uninstrumented application throughput or speedup is reported.
Shared native planning removes per-layer Python rebuild from the main path. Shadow validation and logit copying add measured work, and their disablement must be explicit.
All B1/B2/B3 graphs were captured; this run only exercises B3 replay. B3 to B1 to B3 and prefix remapping boundary coverage remain separate required tests.
The qualifier uses compile mode 3, FULL graphs and 0.80 KV memory utilization. Final performance must match the strongest native production configuration/resources.
